types.description: OTS250G1L/3 long three-pole grey plastic terminal-shroud kit

document.title: ABB Transfer, change-over and bypass switches — Securing your power to perform
document.pages: Printed p.39 (physical PDF p.41); revision on physical p.136

modelingNotes: Exact ABB order 1SCA022731R8150 is OTS250G1L/3: a long, three-pole grey plastic terminal-shroud kit, with snap-on mounting. Catalog p.39 lists three shrouds per type.

The catalog lists OT_160...250_C compatibility and upper-switch use in this change-over assembly context. The ABB product page also lists OT160, OT200 and OT250 families; assembly fit must follow the applicable switch documentation.
IP20 is the catalog protection context for shrouds mounted on switches, not an independent enclosure rating. No supply voltage, current or switching capacity is assigned to this mechanical accessory.

Zero electrical terminals and functions: the three-pole designation identifies coverage of host-switch poles, not conductive poles in the shroud. No power, return, PE/bond, shield, signal or communication connections and no fixed conductive links.
COVER is a mechanical documentation alias only, without electrical pins. Host-switch terminals and any enclosure bonding belong to separate components.

connectionCoverage.notes: Complete for this mechanical plastic shroud kit: zero electrical connections. Covered switch terminals and enclosure bonding are outside this order identity.

COVER.connector: Snap-on terminal shroud for compatible ABB OT switches
COVER.description: Mechanical attachment only; no electrical pins. COVER is an authoring alias.
